articles.title: Imagine Your Dog Saying 'SQUIRREL!' — Talking Pets Could Be Real One Day!
articles.summary: Scientists are getting closer to making animal translators! New AI and listening tools could one day let you chat with your cat or dog. A humpback whale even said 'hello' back in 2023!

articles.title: 50 Years After First Mars Landing, NASA Plans to Fly Helicopters on the Red Planet!
articles.summary: NASA's Viking 1 landed on Mars exactly 50 years ago! Now, the space agency is sending three helicopters in 2028 to explore the skies. Rovers have already found signs of ancient water and possible life.

articles.title: Some Dinosaurs Could Stand Tall Like Giants—Until They Got Too Heavy!
articles.summary: Two South American long-necked dinosaurs could stand on their hind legs, especially when young. But as they grew bigger, their thigh bones got stressed. Scientists used computer models to test this.
